comparison.objective: Lay a sterile dressing over a wound while touching only its edges.
comparison.physical_skill: Delicate deformable-sheet handling with contamination-zone avoidance, unlike rigid-tool impact and fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Dressing must cover the wound with handling restricted to edges; coverage tolerance, contamination geometry, folds, and stability details are absent.
comparison.reason: Sterile deformable placement has a different mechanism and outcome from rigid tang fracture and recovery.
